CAS — 56-45-1 (serine); 302-84-1 (DL-serine). Pharmacopoeias. In Chin., Eur. (see p.vii), and US. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Serine). White or almost white crystalline powder or colourless crystals. Freely soluble in water; practically insolu- ble in alcohol. Protect from light. USP 31 (Serine). White, odourless crystals. Soluble in water; practically insoluble in dehydrated alcohol and in ether. Profile Serine is a non-essential amino acid. It is used as a dietary sup- plement. The racemic form (DL-serine) has been included in iron supple- ments to increase iron absorption.
